Claude Code 或其它支持 SKILL.md 的宿主：把引擎目录放进对应的 skills 路径即可。 目录自包含，无代码依赖，拷进去就能用。
```
git clone https://github.com/Greatbeing/writing-engines.git
cp -r writing-engines/human-voice-writing \
      writing-engines/guanfang-writing \
      writing-engines/feature-writing \
      writing-engines/gongwen-writing \
      writing-engines/sushi-writing \
      writing-engines/luxun-writing \
```

## yogacara-agent
A cognitive evolution framework for AI Agents based on Yogacara (Consciousness-Only) theory
URL: https://github.com/Greatbeing/yogacara-agent
Tags: open
Last push: 2026-11-03
Evidence: 17 test files, no eval results file, last CI success
How to get it (🚀 快速开始): 方式一：使用外部 API（推荐，无需本地 GPU）
```
git clone https://github.com/Greatbeing/yogacara-agent.git
cd yogacara-agent

# 配置 API Key（以 DeepSeek 为例）
export LLM_BASE_URL="https://api.deepseek.com/v1"
export LLM_API_KEY="sk-your-api-key"
export LLM_MODEL="deepseek-chat"

# 安装轻量依赖（仅需 openai, langgraph 等小库）
pip install openai langgraph langchain-core fastapi python-dotenv
# …完整步骤见仓库 README
```
